'''Fush SYCFA Fear My Flip''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 14 October 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 SYCFA Fush DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck is is buildt primarily for fun, but I also want it to do OK in a competitive environment. Please consider both when rating.

== Strategy ==

CARD CHOICES

- Only one FWKTIL(V). I should probably pack two, but SAC is not very common in my area.

- Bespin and TMNALTC is probably not the wisest combo to use in this deck, since I'm essentially giving away the system, and need the D* to move the Executor down. But you can't beat the free Executor for the fun part.

- Put All Sections On Alert. Is this card amazing in this deck or what? And it's a 6!

-Twi'lek Advisors. I'd use WMAOP if I had any.

A FEW STRATEGY NOTES

With Chiraneau and FWKTIL(V) I'll do some serious damage at my low parsec systems. Kuat Drive Yards will pull my destroyers out.

With Mob.Points I'll usually wait 'til I draw the Executor or Kuat and then pull the other. Don't Do That Again won't be a problem, since I'll have no trouble occupying that system.
